class QuotedFields {
  "a.b": number;
  "a%b": string;
  "": boolean;
  "c\u002ed": number;
  1: number;
  constructor() {
    this["a.b"] = 1;
    this["a%b"] = "ok";
    this[""] = true;
    this["c\u002ed"] = 2;
    this[0x1] = 3;
  }
}
const fields = new QuotedFields();
console.log(fields["a.b"], fields["a%b"], fields[""], fields["c.d"], fields[1]);
